cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Nobody received my meeting email. This office has stopped communicating.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's in your drafts. You forgot to send it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. And nobody noticed. Our entire communication system depends on my memory.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send it. Go and have your lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now you're covering communications while I'm absent. We need a succession plan before I take a sandwich.

mechanism: A grades a pupil useful fixes as evidence of an office-wide vulnerability and proposes further training to meet the imagined crisis.
confusable: The larger problem must be inferred from each small fact, not simply announced once and repeated.
comparison: Personal snack details versus routine communications assistance treated as succession risk.
seedUse: Keep D24 unsent draft and helpful send offer; S05 credit for finding the draft becomes a reason for more organizational training.
